_migration: Replaces the built-in fall_detection (YOLOv7-w6-pose). The pose_fall block is the old heuristic's constants verbatim, in the old model's 640x640 stretched space (legacy_640): no recalibration. Known to over-fire on small/distant people and person-shaped objects (docs/BACKLOG.md BL-1). Ultralytics yolo11l-pose (v8.3.0 release asset, sha256 61921abe1f2ed930bf28328a16b3162278cdb239a1e8280b6ac827119f13cee0), unmodified: the model change is the only intended difference. Chosen over yolo11x-pose on the 2026-11-19 replay: same agreement with the old model (87.8% vs 87.6% of 500 frames), faster (median 24.9 vs 27.5 ms) and smaller (436 vs 562 MB peak). The fall rule has no display_name on purpose: fall_detected is stored with no type_detail and is shown under the family label 'Fall Detected', as before.
